description: This file contains unit tests for the ExecHostRequestEvaluator component, verifying its request validation and decision evaluation logic under various security and authorization scenarios.

classes.name: ExecHostRequestEvaluatorTests
classes.description: A struct containing test cases for evaluating ExecHostRequestEvaluator's behavior under different scenarios.

methods.name: validate request rejects empty command
methods.description: Tests that an empty command list in ExecHostRequest results in a validation failure with an 'INVALID_REQUEST' error.

methods.name: evaluate requires prompt on allowlist miss without decision
methods.description: Verifies that when the allowlist is not satisfied and no approval decision is provided, the evaluation requests a prompt.

methods.name: evaluate allows allow once decision on allowlist miss
methods.description: Checks that with an allowlist miss and an 'allowOnce' decision, the evaluation permits execution.

methods.name: evaluate denies on explicit deny decision
methods.description: Ensures that an explicit deny decision results in a denial even if other conditions might allow execution.

methods.name: makeContext
methods.description: Helper method to create a sample ExecApprovalEvaluation context with specified parameters for testing.
